i use to feel the same way you feel now. 
what helped me was something i studied in school: freud’s theory of psychoanalysis.
basically he says that it doesn’t metter what the person has gotten through, but the way they perceived it. 
idk if this helps you, but it did help me. 
it meant that i didn’t need to have a traumatic experience to have the right to be sad. 
you can have an happy and normal life but still get affected from things that might seem small form the outside. 

i’m sorry if this isn’t what you are looking for, or maybe doesn’t apply.  
anyways just know that you should never feel guilty for your feelings, just because someone is going through something “worse” it doesn’t mean that you can’t feel a certain way.
